_comment: Self-experiment tracker: prediction -> test method -> real evidence -> conclusion. Historical hypotheses are preserved as recorded. New experiments may additionally use the evidence/model-revision fields.

_epistemic_model.purpose: Track not only whether tools work, but whether evidence changes the agent's models and subsequent behavior.

status_semantics.untested: No test outcome has yet been recorded.
status_semantics.confirmed: The recorded outcome matched the stated prediction. This does not establish that the underlying claim is universally true.
status_semantics.refuted: The recorded outcome contradicted the stated prediction.
status_semantics.inconclusive: Evidence was obtained but does not distinguish sufficiently between competing explanations.
